items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Roy Haynes, George Duvivier, Skeeter Best on guitar and Frank Wess on tenor and flute on that record.

ctx.x: Do you recall who also was in the rhythm section?

Oh yeah. Roy Haynes, George Duvivier, Skeeter Best on guitar and Frank Wess on tenor and flute on that record. George was very good, George Duvivier. He really organized it good for that date. It really came off very good. He just said okay, this is how we’re going to do it, and blah, blah, blah. And I’d make up some intros, we all made our little contributions and before you knew it five hours was up, or six.
And what did a record date pay back then?
